name: moods
from: written as SVG rather than drawn
//: Eight faces, written as SVG and baked, in place of a set taken from an icon library. What made the difference is the brief rather than the drawing: a circle of ten, few features and big ones, nothing under two units, no enclosed shape under five, and eyes as dots or short strokes and never as small circles — a small circle at 24 dots is a blot. Then eyebrows on every one of them, which is where the expression actually lives: two thick strokes well clear of the eyes, angled, and the biggest features after the mouth. The two brows are two strokes with a clear gap between them, said in the brief in units — left ends by x=10, right starts by x=14 — because asked for only as two brows, two of the seven came back as one line across the face.
//marks: Seven rather than eight, and no sad one. Eight faces are a circle each, which is the widest a mark gets, and eight of them at 36 dots come to 184 cells — past an ordinary terminal, so the whole row fell to 24 and every face with it. Seven come to 160 and it holds. The sleeping one went: a row that jumps on the beat has no use for somebody asleep in the middle of it.
//heights: Two dots of pen rather than three. These are written rather than traced, so nothing needs thickening, and at three the features inside the circle close up.
